parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-24, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1101.7 | 4.18 | 4.18
2 | 1144.4 | 12.44 | 16.62
3 | 549.8 | 0.62 | 17.24
4 | 173.3 | 7.65 | 24.89
5 | 2079.8 | 25.05 | 49.94
6 | 1111.4 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation for the given vertical electrical sounding (VES), we analyze the resistivities of the six layers in depth order:
1. $\rho_1 = 1101.7$ $\Omega\text{m}$
2. $\rho_2 = 1144.4$ $\Omega\text{m}$
3. $\rho_3 = 549.8$ $\Omega\text{m}$
4. $\rho_4 = 173.3$ $\Omega\text{m}$
5. $\rho_5 = 2079.8$ $\Omega\text{m}$
6. $\rho_6 = 1111.4$ $\Omega\text{m}$

We evaluate each group of three consecutive layers using the provided rules:
- **A**: $\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3$
- **Q**: $\rho_1 > \rho_2 > \rho_3$
- **H**: $\rho_1 > \rho_2 < \rho_3$
- **K**: $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$

**Group 1 (Layers 1-2-3):**
$1101.7 < 1144.4 > 549.8 \implies \mathbf{K}$

**Group 2 (Layers 2-3-4):**
$1144.4 > 549.8 > 173.3 \implies \mathbf{Q}$

**Group 3 (Layers 3-4-5):**
$549.8 > 173.3 < 2079.8 \implies \mathbf{H}$

**Group 4 (Layers 4-5-6):**
$173.3 < 2079.8 > 1111.4 \implies \mathbf{K}$

Combining these letters in depth order, we get **KQHK**.

{"curve_type": "KQHK"}
